{{Quote|Hey, Grakko. Umm. Let me pass&hellip;for old time's sake?"<br />"''Love'' to. ''Can't''. Job specifically requires you dead. You're a nice thief, but you must die now.|[[Khaleen Hentz/Legends|Khaleen Hentz]] and Grakko|<ref name="Republic 49">[[Republic 49|''Republic'' 49]]</ref>}}
'''Grakko''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] who worked for the [[Falleen/Legends|Falleen]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Zenex]] on [[The Wheel/Legends|''the Wheel'']] [[Space station/Legends|space station]].

==Biography==
Grakko was tasked with killing [[Khaleen Hentz/Legends|Khaleen Hentz]], whom he had encountered at some point in the past, after she had stolen an important [[Hologram disc/Legends|holodisc]] from Zenex. Grakko caught up with her on the [[maintenance level]]s of The Wheel, where they engaged in a brief fight. The fight ended when Khaleen set off a detonator that was still attached to Grakko's utility belt. Grakko was killed in the explosion.
